turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on polite requests?
turns.tutor:
Let me show you one first: Bring me some juice.
Step 1: Bring me sounds like an order, so I take it out. Step 2: I begin with I would like. Step 3: I put please at the end. Result: I would like some juice, please.
The rule: start with Can I have or I would like, and finish with please.
Right: Can I have a sandwich, please? Wrong: Bring me a sandwich.
Now your turn. Write one polite sentence.
Make this polite: "Give me a coffee."
